limitations: Authorized Decision OS #11 source/measurement review: bounded public numerical excerpts from several identified publishers. This session curation is not a single original-agency publication, a new independent upstream, a licensed public data feed, or an automatic refresh. Core WB/EIA oil/gas and the prior 435 series are not repeated.

RAW RELATIONAL CSV for existing read-source: context rows contain shared original metadata; series rows contain one series and one or two observations. Join same-file context_id and inherit exactly the JSON-listed context_fields, even if its value is empty. Identical source flags may be inherited within the same dataset, seasonal treatment and period; varying flags remain on their own series. Other original fields use the series string. No blank fallback, cross-file context, recursive context or implicit metadata inference. Read all records in a shard; contexts are never observations.

Every shard is self-contained. All original numerical cells/pointers were checked against retained file bytes; original PNG tables were independently visually verified, not claimed as machine OCR. Raw decimal strings/Excel parsed values and any differing equivalent XML spelling are retained. Lossless restoration of the 36 original fields and existing read-source raw selection were checked locally. Native custody/execution requires separate root receipts.

Original response URL/bytes/SHA, dates, period basis, units, seasonal treatment, revisions, estimates, locators and rights are retained in series/context fields. The Ember receipt covers an HTTP206 fragment only. One Comtrade record has only 2025: second period/value remains absent. Two measures of that record count as one original Comtrade record, not two.

Indices, rates, physical flows, end-period stocks, nominal inventory value, apparent consumption, three-month moving-average sales and historical samples keep distinct meanings. Totals/components and compilers/national sources overlap. No back-solving, interpolation, silent zero, instrument/price mapping or statistical aggregation is performed. This raw relation is not the 16-column industry reader.

Attribution and the narrow per-source rights judgment travel with these factual excerpts. Necessary numerical-fact judgments for some official/public releases do not assert unrestricted source database licences. Whole source PDFs, images, prose, graphics, credentials and paid histories are excluded. SourceInput origin is session curation provenance; unknown original publication dates remain blank.

RIGHTS census_m3: These are Census government survey numerical facts from two months, with original labels, units and revision flags. Inspected Census API terms allow display/analysis with attribution; a general XLSX-specific copyright notice was not directly verified. This is not a blanket licence assertion or release of respondent records. Terms: https://www.census.gov/data/developers/about/terms-of-service.html
